## `src/composables/use-intersection-observer/use-intersection-observer`

### useIntersectionObserver

**Kind:** function

```typescript
function useIntersectionObserver(target: MpRef<Element | null>, callback: IntersectionObserverCallback, options?: IntersectionObserverInit): void
```

Framework-neutral IntersectionObserver hook.
Watches for changes in the intersection of a target element with an ancestor
element or with a top-level document's viewport.

SSR-safe: no-op when the browser API or DOM is unavailable.
Automatic cleanup: disconnects the observer on unmount.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| target | MpRef<Element \| null> |  |
| callback | IntersectionObserverCallback |  |
| options | IntersectionObserverInit |  |

### usePerformanceObserver

**Kind:** function

```typescript
function usePerformanceObserver(callback: PerformanceObserverCallback, options?: PerformanceObserverInit): void
```

Framework-neutral PerformanceObserver hook.
Watches for new performance entries as they are recorded in the browser's
performance log.

SSR-safe: no-op when the browser API is unavailable.
Automatic cleanup: disconnects the observer on unmount.
